query: 首席独立董事 首席独立董事 衡量企业是否设立首席独立董事（或资深独立董事）职位的制度化程度及其实际发挥的监督作用。重点考察其授权范围、召集权、对董事长的制衡能力及履职透明度。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越/高分）：设有首席独立董事；具备明确的职权清单（如：在董事长缺席或回避时主持会议、批准董事会会议日程）；拥有独立召集权（可定期在无内部董事参与的情况下召集独董会议）；并详细披露了年度履职报告或具体贡献。 • 1分（合格/中低分）：名义上设立了首席独立董事或类似职位，但在公司章程或治理报告中缺乏具体的职权边界说明，且未见其独立行使召集权或监督权的实质记录。 • 0分（不合格）：未设立首席独立董事，或在董事长与 CEO 合一的情况下未建立任何抵消性的独立治理机制。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：首席独立董事的职权已正式写入《公司章程》或《董事会议事规则》，且覆盖集团所有核心治理决策环节。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：仅在个别委员会（如审计委）中发挥牵头作用，或仅作为临时性安排，未形成制度化的长效机制。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关制度覆盖。 首席独立董事 资深独立董事 首席独立非执行董事 独董召集人 召集独董会议 纯独董会议 批准董事会议程 制衡董事长 股东沟通联系人 履职报告 SID LID Lead Independent Director Senior Independent Director Lead Independent Non-Executive Director LID SID convene independent directors independent directors-only meeting executive session board agenda approval checks on the chair shareholder liaison 是否设立首席独立董事、资深独立董事或实质等同职位？ 职权是否包括主持会议、批准或建议议程？ 可否在无执行董事或管理层参与下召集独董会议？ 是否作为股东与董事会沟通联系人并制衡董事长？ 是否披露年度履职？ 职权是否写入章程、议事规则或治理文件？

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with suppliers
results.text: The Group found that the qualification of outsourced supplier is weak while their quality is unstable. There is negligence in the work to promote the improvement of quality abnormality, and the outsourced suppliers fail to conduct continuous tracking to confirm the improvement effect after significant anomalies. In 2021, the Group assigned relevant staff to hold a QTI meeting lasting about one hour every day with suppliers, at which mainly review the significant abnormalities in the manufacturing procedure, external inspection and rejection, the yield rate of anode final inspection, and various checks and operation status of inspectors.

[Content]
The Group found that the qualification of outsourced supplier is weak while their quality is unstable. There is negligence in the work to promote the improvement of quality abnormality, and the outsourced suppliers fail to conduct continuous tracking to confirm the improvement effect after significant anomalies. In 2021, the Group assigned relevant staff to hold a QTI meeting lasting about one hour every day with suppliers, at which mainly review the significant abnormalities in the manufacturing procedure, external inspection and rejection, the yield rate of anode final inspection, and various checks and operation status of inspectors.

results.text: Ju Teng International classifies all the suppliers into different levels (A/B/C/D) by the quality of the supplier's products and services and the degree of risk involved. Ju Teng International has conducted a risk assessment based on the risk items listed in the 'Supplier's Basic Information Table'. High-risk suppliers (scores below 80) are required to provide a rectification plan and make rectification, and if the rectification is not completed within the agreed period, the audit qualification of these suppliers will be cancelled. In addition, all Production Plants of Ju Teng International have introduced new procurement categories such as moulds, auxiliary materials, and equipment to strengthen centralised management of the procurement process.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE OPERATION / Mutual success with suppliers
results.text: Ju Teng International clarifies the cooperation, communication, and management model with suppliers and potential suppliers at all stages through the 'Supplier Management Procedure'. Through effective management of suppliers, Ju Teng International understands suppliers' quality, price, delivery, coordination, labour, environmental protection, safety, ethics and other relevant information, and follows up and deals with supplier problems in a timely manner. For different types of suppliers, Ju Teng International has different management processes in order to manage them in a more targeted manner. For example, for the management of non-enclosure suppliers, Ju Teng International revised the relevant management requirements (on-site audit, production part approval process (PPAP) submission, quality technical agreement terms, etc.). After an abnormal problem occurs, the 8D or applicable problem solving procedures are initiated so that the abnormal problem can be solved in a timely and thorough manner.
